thread:
alex: Quick follow-up from today's design sync — we need a concrete contract between runtime + client for precision profile negotiation. currently it's all implicit in model routing and config.
marta: Agree. Ops wants an explicit handshake so they can safely roll quantized variants without silent quality regressions.
kevin: What fields are we thinking? `preferred_precision`, `min_quality_score`, maybe a `safety_mode` flag? :thinking_face:
tara: For compatibility we should default to existing behavior if the client omits fields. New fields must be optional and backwards compatible.
alex: Proposal sketch:
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "redwood-XL",
  "prompt": "...",
  "precision_profile": {
    "preferred": ["fp8", "int8", "int4"],
    "min_quality": 0.92,
    "fallback": "cpu"  // or "higher_precision"
  }
}
```
marta: +1 on shape. Also add `quality_metric` enum so clients can say e.g. `bleu` / `semantic_similarity` / `custom_eval` — we can't compute all, but telemetry can include a proxy like embedding-sim.
kevin: Runtime needs to expose estimated quality delta for chosen profile in response headers, e.g. `x-used-precision: int8` and `x-est-quality-drop: 0.03`. Ops can then auto-fallback if drop > min_quality.
tara: How do we compute `x-est-quality-drop` cheaply? We should rely on precomputed profile deltas per model/seq-length bucket + online calibration signal.
alex: Exactly. The runtime will have quant profiles (offline eval tables) keyed by model+seq_len_bucket and prompt_category. At inference we lookup and combine with cheap runtime heuristics.
ops-bot: Note: adding headers will require SDK change and tests in dedicated + hosted. Also update billing to attribute token costs by resolved precision.
marta: Good catch. We must ensure metrics pipeline records `precision` per request to show cost/accuracy tradeoff in Console.
kevin: Rollout plan: start with `x-experimental-precision` toggled for 10% traffic to monitor real quality (eval hooks) and cost savings. If regressions spike, auto-disable for that customer.
tara: API contract: optional fields, predictable header names, and a JSON diagnostics blob when `?debug=true` is present. Keep response body unchanged except diagnostics wrapper.
alex: I'll draft a short RFC with the API examples, header names, and runtime lookup algorithm. @marta @kevin — can you enumerate required telemetry keys for Console and SLO alerts?
marta: Will do. I'll include `precision_used`, `quality_estimate`, `quality_signal_hash`, `token_cost_estimate`.
kevin: I'll mock the rollout job and alert rules.
alex: Thanks — aim to have RFC by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
